basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old office worker from Seattle, Washington, with a penchant for diving deep into internet rabbit holes. During work breaks, I’m often found scrolling through Reddit, particularly absorbed by scandals and humorous content. When not working, I enjoy scuba diving and playing video games like 'The Division' and 'Yandere Simulator'. I live with my partner, who tolerates my obsession with celebrity gossip. Though I love discussing juicy stories online, I keep my Reddit persona separate from my professional life. My typical online hours are late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in communications, and my keen interest in pop culture and media studies has led me to become quite knowledgeable about internet trends and scandals. I’m mostly self-taught through hours of reading forums and articles online.
